evidence.observation: 3.014 Torr at start of growth, matching the ramp baseline of about 3.01-3.03 Torr
Rose steadily to 3.361 Torr (about +0.1 Torr every 120 s from t=2760)
Argon flow steady at about 100 sccm, matching the setpoint, so the rise is not from extra inflow
Temperature steady at about 750 °C with normal heater power, so thermal control looks fine
Sensor not installed; the atmosphere cannot be checked

args.missing_evidence: No exhaust O2 or leak-check reading, so I can't tell an exhaust or pump-line blockage from a seal leak letting air in. Two checks would settle it: a rate-of-rise leak test with the tube isolated, or an inspection of the exhaust line and pump valve. No characterization of the sample exists yet.
